description.narrative:
Contribution is Swedens assistance via Sida to EIB trustfund EBTATF for technical assistance to projects financed by EIB in the Eastern Partnership countries.
Distribution: No country allocations in advance.

Insatsen avser svenskt bidrag via Sida till EIBs multifond Eastern Partnership Technical Assistance Trust Fund, EPTATF, för tekniskt bistånd i projekt som finansieras av Europeiska Investeringsbanken, EIB, inom ramen för EIBs verksamhet inom Östliga Partnerskapet.

EIB: The overall objective for the European Union's priorities in the East is prosperity, stability and safety, which also forms EIB's mandate for the Eastern Partnership. The Eastern Partnership Technical Assistance Trust Fund is a multi-year standing fund. Its purpose is to enable the European Investment Bank to provide technical assistance to improve the quality and development impact of the Bank's Eastern Partnership operations through targeted technical support.
EPTATF: The EPTATF is expected to contribute to the following overall objectives: sustainable socio-economic development in Eastern Partnership Countries in line with the EIBs revised external lending mandate; and capacity development in Eastern Partnership Countries(institutional, regulatory, organisational and individual) for preparation and implementation of infrastructure investments including urban development and climate change mitigation and adaptation.
The delivery of TA aims to facilitate investment by supporting project preparation and implementation in the region. The priority sectors are:
- local private sector development, enhanced access to finance for SMEs
- development of social and economic infrastructure, and;
- climate change mitigation and adaptation.
EPTATF has implemented the Strategic Priorities for 2021-2027 to be in line with the EU agenda for EaP countries and are focused on reinforcing resilient, sustainable and integrated economies, environment and climate resilience and digital transformation.

description.narrative:
The fund has disbursed MEUR 31.7 linked to 44 approved projects. During 2023 two new projects were approved and as many as 8 projects were completed:
Armenica Public buildings Energy Efficiency
Georgia Energy Storage Strategy for grid
Georgia Zemo Sagori Irrigation Project
Georgia Promoting finance and climate action for SMEs through the banking sector
Georgia Tera bank
Moldova Energy Efficiency
Moldova and Ukraine Agri-Food apex loans
These projects have mainly contributed to large savings of energy as well as additional financing to SMEs and the banking sector, contributing to thousands of jobs.
This has mobilised financing of more than BEUR 5.2, of which BEUR 4.7 comes from EIB.
The expected impact from EPTATF as described on the website is the following:
118,000 people employed in construction each year
Safe drinking water for over 66,700 people
More than 2.4 million people with improved connectivity, energy efficiency and secure energy supply
The annual report reports on many more indicators and of course the actual impact depends very much on what type of projects that actually happen in the end. As of now it appears that number of jobs are in line with expectation, while people with access to safe drinking water exceeds expectations a lot.
The annual report is very detailed on project level, but could preferrably be also aggregated in order to show impact on the fund level in a more detailed way.
Procurements related to the projects have benefitted companies from mainly Germany, UK, France, Italy and Denmark, but also from 11 other countries, but not Sweden.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
